headers.//: Default: never let a phone hold on to the HTML shell. Broad rule first so every route is covered, including rewritten paths like /pack.

script-src needs apis.google.com: the Auth SDK loads gapi for its sign-in iframe. frame-src needs the authDomain for that same iframe. style-src needs unsafe-inline for React's style={{...}} progress bars. Adding App Check later also needs www.google.com and www.gstatic.com in script-src/frame-src.
headers.value: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' https://apis.google.com; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data:; font-src 'self'; connect-src 'self' https://*.googleapis.com wss://*.googleapis.com https://open.er-api.com; frame-src https://nomad-pack-list.firebaseapp.com https://apis.google.com; worker-src 'self'; manifest-src 'self'; base-uri 'none'; object-src 'none'; form-action 'self'; frame-ancestors 'none'

headers.//: Build assets carry a content hash, so they can be cached hard. A new build simply requests a new filename.
These two decide whether an update is even noticed — they must always hit the server.
